name: Road to De Other Side: the Gutdevourer aims Venomous Breath at a player, then sweeps it slowly to one side
contract: Issue #10957: the Gutdevourer (162773) is supposed to turn while it channels Venomous Breath (256907, 3 s cast, then a 5 s channel that fires the 11 yd cone 256908 every 0.5 s). Expected (project owner decision, checked in game): the cast is aimed at a random player and held without following them; once the channel starts the Gutdevourer turns slowly to the left or right, a quarter turn over the channel, and every cone tick uses the facing at that moment, so the hits follow the visible breath.

steps.label: p hits the Gutdevourer and starts the fight
SETUP: the Gutdevourer channels Venomous Breath
DISCRIMINATING: the channel starts aimed at p, the only player
DISCRIMINATING: 2 s into the channel the breath has turned about 36 degrees away from p
the cone hit p while it still pointed at them
4 s into the channel it keeps turning the same way, about 72 degrees
the hits follow the facing: no tick reached p after the breath turned away
